support_library.support_rule: Every nonempty subset of the exponent set having cardinality at most two.
support_library.coefficient_field: Q for every sentinel search; complex algebraic roots of the exact coefficient ideal are retained.

invariance_identities.clearing_rule: Use exact rational cancellation and set every coefficient of each canonical numerator to zero.
invariance_identities.ideal_rule: Compute an exact Groebner basis over Q for the coefficient equations plus the exact-support saturation equation.
invariance_identities.unit_ideal: A basis containing 1 is an exact no-graph decision for that template.
invariance_identities.non_unit_ideal: Retain the basis, dimension classification, and all exact branches obtainable within the locked limits for candidate audit.
invariance_identities.unresolved_rule: A timeout, exception, resource abort, or non-unit ideal lacking a complete branch representation makes the campaign INCOMPLETE.

enumeration.ordering: mass_order_case, shape_cover, lexicographic v support, lexicographic u support

candidate_promotion.sentinel_status: A graph found at one or more sentinels is only a discovery candidate.
candidate_promotion.mass_extension: Solve or reconstruct a symbolic m1,m2,m3 branch and prove its denominators cover every finite positive mass triple, or prove a finite exhaustive branch partition.
candidate_promotion.full_lift: Recover r from r'=r*v, recover a=r*x and b=r*(1-x), reconstruct barycentric q_i and physical velocities, and verify the full Newton equations and H=C=0.
candidate_promotion.mr_gate: Only a signed QUALIFIED_WITNESS may create WP6-DZ-MR-v1.

compute_policy.determinism: Single declared SymPy version, exact rational arithmetic, fixed variable order, no randomized algorithms.
compute_policy.checkpointing: Append-only deterministic shards may be merged only when their system IDs and input hashes match the lock.
compute_policy.scope_change: Any changed cap, cover, support, mass case, solver field, or identity requires WP6-DZ-FEAS-v3.
